family: The single fixed total certificate-free language in family.py and proof.md. For N>=2 let L=floor(log2 N), J=ceil(log2(L+2)), k=floor(2^10000*L^11/J); k>N or failed exact metadata guards return zero. Set m=floor(k/(2^300 L^2)), h=pow2ceil(2^200 L^2), ell=2^300 L^2, d=2^64*(h^2*ell+L), E=2^200 L^2. A supplied bounded-order diagonal-orbit linear extractor provides Short and all long calls with their exact paid entropy thresholds. Indexed alternating extraction with postponed full-current-Q observations and the monotone polynomial-graph resilient map with delta=1/2^20 supply the output. All N bits are payload; every field and ordering is uniform, with no advice or witness input. Runtime is one fixed polynomial with an enormous degree.
theorem: For this one fixed total uniform language in P, hence NP with empty witnesses, there exist fixed K>0 and N0 such that C_B2(F_N)>=4N-K*(log2 N)^11/(log2 log2 N) for every integer actual length N>=N0 in the full pinned B2 model. The supplied complete bounded-order diagonal extraction, correlation with the supplied smaller weak-seed defect, resilience and fixed-factor accounting prove affine dispersal at the exact k, and the full kernel gives 4N-8k. This same complete guarantee implies the joint finite projection (4,1).
